moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 40
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 3
Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description:
Fighting (Physical)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.description:
Fire (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Vacuum Wave
moves.description:
Fighting (Special)
Base Power: 40
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 1
No additional effect.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description:
Grass (Special)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.description:
Dark (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
Raises the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.description:
Fire (Physical)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Flare Blitz
moves.description:
Fire (Physical)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to burn the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description:
Fighting (Physical)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Choice Scarf
items.description: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

items.name: Expert Belt
items.description: Holder's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.2x damage.

items.name: White Herb
items.description: Restores all lowered stat stages to 0 when one is less than 0. Single use.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Payapa Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Psychic-type attack. Single use.

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.description: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.

abilities.name: Iron Fist
abilities.description: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.2.
